agent_notes.else: Completed competitor analysis (2026-04-06). Analyzed 6 competitors: Notion, Obsidian, Bear, Evernote, Apple Notes, Roam Research. Key finding: the $3-8/mo cross-platform tier is underserved. Identified 5 market gaps including onboarding vs. power, collaboration + privacy, and meaningful AI integration. Pricing recommendation summary passed to nora: freemium with ~$6-8/mo individual and ~$8-10/user/mo team tier. Output: projects/test-autodispatch/output/2026-04-06-competitor-analysis.md
agent_notes.nora: Completed pricing recommendation (2026-04-06). Designed three-tier freemium model: Free (2 devices, 1 GB, no AI), Pro at $7/mo ($70/yr), Team at $9/user/mo ($90/user/yr). AI included in Pro (not a separate add-on) as key differentiator against Notion. Revenue model projects ~$84K ARR at 1,000 paying customers. Recommended freemium over paid-only. Output: projects/test-autodispatch/output/2026-04-06-pricing-recommendation.md
agent_notes.dag: Completed infrastructure and CI/CD (2026-04-06). Produced Dockerfile (python:3.12-slim, non-root user, stdlib healthcheck), docker-compose.yml for local dev, .env.example, .dockerignore, and a three-job GitHub Actions workflow (test -> build-and-push to ghcr.io -> Railway deploy with post-deploy health check). Zero-downtime via Railway rolling deploy + HEALTHCHECK directive. Bjorn architecture output was not yet available (Phase 1 parallel run) — assumptions documented in output file. Output: projects/test-autodispatch/output/2026-04-06-infrastructure-and-cicd.md
agent_notes.bjorn: Completed system architecture (2026-04-06). FastAPI + Python on Railway. Quotes in bundled quotes.json (no DB). Daily quote selected deterministically by (day_of_year - 1) % len(quotes) — no shared state needed. In-process dict cache keyed by ISO date. 4 ADRs: static file over DB, deterministic over random, in-process cache over Redis, UTC date boundary. Component file map provided for Arve (main.py, routers/quote.py, services/quote_service.py, data/quotes.json, tests/test_quote.py). Output: projects/test-autodispatch/output/2026-04-06-system-architecture.md
